facts.text: You found Ashlyn holding the square with what was left of her company.
Ashlyn asked you to search the church for Thendrick and Mathilda.
The eastern barricade is repaired. The square is no longer open to the street.
Miruna set you on the drowned bell: find the clapper in the flooded stores.
Miruna told you what she knows about the crypt, and that something down there calls her by name.
The bell's clapper is out of the flooded store.
The dead in the storeroom are down. The water is still.
You camped under the sun-disc. Wounds closed and prepared spells came back.
The bell spoke once over the mist, and answering lights kindled in the village below.
The last of the infected fell in the square, and the square held.
Ashlyn came through the fight in the square alive.
Corvin yielded the crypt without a fight and gave you the bell's tongue.
The Gate-Warden came apart like wet parchment.
The crypt is open and whatever held the bell's memory has let go.

questions.text: What is still talking in the crypt?
